Sets the host name to use for LDAP
authentication.
When this option is specified, the module will
provide LDAP authentication. This parameter
is required if any other LDAP parameter is
specified.
There is no default for this parameter.

Sets the port number to use for LDAP
authentication.
When this option is specified, the module will
provide LDAP authentication and an
LDAP.Host must also be specified.
Default: 389
